messages:
alejandra: heads-up i'm about to open a docs PR: 'private/VPC migration appendix' — small, single-page appendix that pulls together a handful of common customer fixes: MTU troubleshooting notes, a minimal PKCS#11 HSM config example, an air-gapped bundle checksum step, a compact installer vs runtime ports checklist, and a tiny JS SDK proxy example. need 1-2 reviewers.

mike: sounds useful. please include the exact ports we recommend for installer-only vs runtime-only traffic. customers ask that a lot.

alejandra: will do. keeping it compact: installer: 443 (downloads), 22 (optional ssh), 2379 (etcd), 3000-3100 (bootstrap) ; runtime: 6443 (k8s api), 10250 (kubelet), 50051 (internal rpc), 9000 (metrics). adding a note about ephemeral NAT egress ports.

jin: old HSM vendor link in the current doc is 404. i found a replacement: https://hsm-vendor.example.com/linux-pkcs11-guide — i'll paste it into the PR. also add a short "pkcs11 load errors" checklist (permissions, wrong lib path, SELinux contexts).

emily: re checksum for air-gapped bundles: sha256 is fine. i can validate the snippet on sealed-site-qa1 once PR is up.

alejandra: proposed snippet: 

```
# build host
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# sealed-site target (after copy)
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
```

emily: i'll run that and report back. if it fails we'll add a note about carriage returns from windows scp'ing and how to use `dos2unix` on the .sha256.

ops-tim: MTU note: on a 1400 path we saw etcd snapshot restores stall due to chunk sizes assuming 1500. repro steps: run a 100MB snapshot restore with MTU=1400 and watch for repeated FIN/RSTs. also kube-apiserver websocket streams to long-lived clients had slow TLS handshakes until we tuned `--max-request-bytes`. i'll paste the exact reproducer to the PR comments.

jin: adding minimal PKCS#11 example to PR: 

```ini
# /etc/redwood/hsm.conf
pkcs11_library = /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
slot_label = "redwood-hsm-slot"
pin = "****"
read_only = false
```

jin: and quick verify commands: `ldd /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so` , `getenforce` (for selinux), and `strace -f -e open /usr/bin/redwood --hsm-test` for missing deps. small bullet list under troubleshooting.

emily: noticed a deprecated field in our JS SDK offline example: `rejectUnauthorized: false` — we shouldn't encourage that. propose this minimal node fetch + proxy snippet instead: 

```js
// node fetch with proxy agent (offline build / sealed site)
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const HttpsProxyAgent = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent('http://proxy.local:3128');

await fetch('https://redwood.example/api/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  agent,
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })
});
```

emily: add a short note about `no_proxy` env var and DOCKER_BUILDKIT when building images that need to reach offline proxies. customers often forget that.

alejandra: good catch. i'll include a one-line DOCKER_BUILDKIT note and an example ENV:

```
# during docker build / CI
export DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1
export HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.local:3128
export NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,redwood.internal
```

mike: i'll review this afternoon. focus on port list accuracy and the MTU repro wording. if emily confirms checksum on sealed-site-qa1 i'll merge. :thumbsup: 

docs-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch docs/private-vpc-migration-appendix (build #452) :construction_worker:

emily: running sha256 check now on sealed-site-qa1. will post results in ~15m.

# end of thread
